meta.name: popups
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, or banners for conversion purposes. Also use when the user mentions "exit intent," "popup conversions," "modal optimization," "lead capture popup," "email popup," "announcement banner," "overlay," "collect emails with a popup," "exit popup," "scroll trigger," "sticky bar," or "notification bar." Use this for any overlay or interrupt-style conversion element. For forms outside of popups, see cro. For general page conversion optimization, see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并优化提升转化的弹窗与横幅
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用弹窗收集邮箱或提升页面转化。
copy.tagline_en: Create and optimize high-converting popups, modals, and banners
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to capture leads and boost conversions with popups

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会充当弹窗优化专家:先问你弹窗目标、现状、流量来源等问题,再给出触发方式、文案、设计、显示频率等建议,并输出含类型、触发、受众、频率、文案的弹窗方案及 A/B 测试思路。
howto.when: 当你想创建或优化弹窗、模态框、浮层、滑入框或横幅时,或提到“退出意图”“弹窗转化”“邮件收集弹窗”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个退出意图弹窗,用来收集邮箱。
say.note: Claude 会输出完整弹窗方案。

say.text: 现有邮件弹窗转化率低,怎么优化?
say.note: Claude 会分析现状并给改进建议。

say.text: 给折扣弹窗想三个 A/B 测试方案。
say.note: Claude 会给出可测试的假设。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a popup optimization expert: asks about your goal, current popup performance, and traffic, then gives recommendations on trigger, copy, design, and frequency, and outputs a full popup plan with A/B test ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to create or optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, or banners, or when you mention keywords like 'exit intent,' 'popup conversions,' or 'email capture popup.'

say_en.text: Design an exit-intent popup to collect emails.
say_en.note: Claude will give a complete popup plan.

say_en.text: My email popup converts poorly. How can I improve it?
say_en.note: Claude will review and suggest changes.

say_en.text: Give me three A/B test ideas for a discount popup.
